title: IET Renewable Power Generation (Wiley NJD v5, two columns)

external.name: Wiley NJD v5 class
external.instructions: Download Wiley's NJD v5 LaTeX template (https://authors.wiley.com/author-resources/Journal-Authors/Prepare/new-journal-design.html, or the Overleaf 'Wiley New Journal Design version 5' template) and copy these files into that folder. The class also needs the ebgaramond, algorithms and algorithmicx LaTeX packages.
